paraphrase: No deception of any kind: the title, icon, description, screenshots and category must describe what the app really does; no impossible or joke features; no mimicking system warnings or other apps; no changing device settings outside the app without consent, and any consented change must be reversible; no misleading people into disabling other apps; no tools for faking IDs or documents; and, further down the page, no manipulated media presented as real, no undisclosed permission use, and no dishonest behaviour enabled for others.
quote: Apps must not attempt to mimic functionality or warnings from the operating system or other apps.
